evidence.explanation: JS create_door uses its injected random argument, defaulting to rn2 and supplied by the production des.door environment, in place of direct C rn2 calls.
evidence.proof: 48 public room-wall door cases in a fixed five-by-five room with open exterior: four walls, fixed/random position, two seeds, random/closed/secret states. Exact C create_door/rnddoor/okdoor/bydoor replay the production JS draw tape with requested bounds and full consumption checked; resulting door coordinates/type/five-bit mask agree. The C caller prelude reproduces the random-state discarded rnddoor draw. No independent RNG or arbitrary-room proof.
evidence.control: 32 explicit closed/secret cases skip the random-state resolution draws while retaining random wall-choice retries and optional position draws;16 random-state targets match.
